title: Race services — bag drop, MSC pace group, rapid assistance, showers
claims: The bag-drop service had to be booked in advance; runners who booked it carry a coat-hanger icon on the bib, and it cannot be added later.
The MSC Prácticos pace group sets a steady pace from start to finish for a target finishing time and carries a highly visible banner identifiable at the start.
Three rapid assistance points by Farmacia Ribera at km 24.5, 29.5 and 34.2 provide vaseline and analgesic spray, with a post-finish point as well.
Medal engraving is an optional paid service located next to the bag-drop area on Avenida del Profesor López Piñero, recording name and official time on the medal.
A shower service runs after the race from 10:00 to 17:00 at the San Luis municipal swimming pool.
The detailed race guide covering getting to the Expo and start line was marked Coming soon on the official services page checked on 2026-11-25.
